assumptions.setup: M15 direction is generated from completed M15 candles using the existing engine default configuration.
assumptions.entries: Baseline enters at the next M15 open; M5 experiment enters at the next M5 open after EMA9/21 alignment and EMA9 pullback/reclaim; M1 experiment requires M5 EMA9/21 alignment plus an M1 EMA9 pullback and close beyond the prior three-candle micro swing, entering at the next M1 open.
assumptions.commonRisk: All methods use the same 1.5 x M15 ATR risk distance measured at the M15 setup close.
assumptions.commonExit: All outcomes are resolved on M1 candles, with a 60-minute horizon and same-candle stop/target touches marked ambiguous.
assumptions.positionConcurrency: Each entry method is simulated independently with at most one open position at a time. Later setups are skipped while a prior position remains open; unresolved outcomes reserve the full 60-minute horizon. Reports distinguish overlap-skipped setups from eligible setups with no entry.
assumptions.costs: No spread, commission or slippage assumptions are applied because broker-specific historical cost data is not part of this archive. Results are gross candle-based R, not executable or realised account returns.
assumptions.splits: Chronological 60% discovery, 20% validation and 20% holdout; a one-hour post-boundary embargo is excluded before validation and holdout, and setups whose 60-minute outcome horizon would cross a split end are purged. Holdout is not used for tuning.
